items.title: Why is Moderna (MRNA) stock soaring today
items.summary: Shares of biotechnology company Moderna (NASDAQ:MRNA) jumped 6.4% in the afternoon session after the company reported third-quarter 2026 financial results, with revenue rising 29% to $1.3 billion, and raised its full-year revenue growth forecast.

items.title: Is Moderna (MRNA) Priced For Too Much Sales Growth?
items.summary: Moderna has turned into one of the market’s sharpest movers, and after such a powerful run, the key issue for you is whether the current share price still lines up with what its sales can support. A stock can move very quickly when sentiment swings on new data or approvals, so the question is how that rapid repricing stacks up against the revenue Moderna is generating today and what investors expect it to produce next.
